items.title: Restore the executable bit on package.json bin targets when dist is promoted
items.context: Probe rp-mtk46lj8-90q9av and review rr-mtk4acx4-oqze5c establish that TypeScript emits non-executable bin files. promoteDist must validate and restore every package.json bin target on the staging tree before evicting the current dist. Final symlinks and intermediate-symlink escapes are rejected; only absent targets are benign.
items.userSees: After npm --prefix packages/main run build re-emits dist, proof-or-stop --version prints the compiled version instead of permission denied; POSIX keeps executable mode bits and Windows keeps a validated npm command shim bound to the promoted CLI.

happy.desc: Before old-dist eviction, promoteDist validates and restores each declared staging bin target: POSIX targets gain executable mode bits while Windows preserves a byte-identical Node entrypoint compatible with npm-generated command shims
The registered red regression exits zero with the GREEN summary after the promotion repair

items.title: Make doctor verify the global executable realpath and mode with an exact repoint remediation
items.context: Draft symptom: /opt/homebrew/bin/proof-or-stop resolved into .worktrees/B-fe8f. Extend core/runtime-environment-checks.ts checkGlobalCoreRealpath (see tests/global-core-realpath.test.mjs) to also assert the bin target is executable and print the exact npm link / repoint command.
items.userSees: proof-or-stop doctor prints a global-cli row with realpath, version and mode, and a one-line remediation when any of them drift

happy.desc: Doctor emits the host-independent global-core pass marker only after the resolved package and PATH-selected command agree and the host executable contract is verified
The cross-platform fixture validates POSIX executable access and an actual representative Windows npm command shim instead of treating Windows executable state as unconditional

edge.desc: When the global package is absent the row is informational and names how to link one
When the global package exists but no proof-or-stop command resolves on PATH, doctor does not emit the pass marker and provides a host-valid relink command
The fixture cannot emit the must selector after a zero-assertion or whole-suite capability skip; non-link Windows assertions still execute

adversarial.desc: Realpath drift renders exact host-shell remediation: POSIX uses quoted shell commands and Windows uses an encoded PowerShell LiteralPath payload that preserves spaces, apostrophes, and percent tokens
Final or intermediate bin-target symlink escapes and realpath probe failures remain non-pass with resolved-path or errno evidence
A missing, unreadable, or target-mismatched Windows npm command shim remains non-pass and never emits the healthy contract marker

verificationEvidence.note: Case 6 of the test: empty global root and null npm root -g both produce an informational pass row naming the npm link command.
The three pre-existing cases (worktree-built CLI resolving to the canonical main checkout accepted; unrelated drift and non-git fallback warn) still pass, plus case 4 (0644 bin target).

Case 4: non-executable bin target warns with chmod +x <abs path>; case 5: realpath inside a .worktrees/ checkout warns with the exact repoint (cd -- <canonical core root> && npm link); neither passes silently.

doctor (dist/cli.js entry) renders the global-core-realpath row with realpath, version, mode and executable flag on this machine; the row is produced by checkGlobalCoreRealpath in core/runtime-environment-checks.ts. Selector no longer pins the CLI version literal so version bumps on main do not invalidate it.
